[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/redfin-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/redfin-scraper.md)

示例爬虫，用于收集来自 Redfin.com 的房产列表数据，使用 Python 和 [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) 网页抓取 API 编写。属于 [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.zh-CN.md) 项目。

- **指南:** [How to Scrape Redfin Real Estate Property Data in Python](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-redfin)
- **代码:** [`redfin.py`](redfin.py) · **示例运行:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **测试:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **示例输出:** [Property pages for sale](results/properties_for_sale.json) · [Property pages for rent](results/properties_for_rent.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## 抓取内容

- Redfin 房产搜索，查找房产列表
- Redfin 房产页面，获取出租/出售房产列表数据

## 函数

- `scrape_search(url)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape search data from the searh API
- `scrape_property_for_sale(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape properties for sale data from HTML
- `scrape_property_for_rent(urls)` → `list[Dict]`: scrape properties for rent from the API

这些函数是 `async` 函数：请使用 `asyncio.run(...)` 运行，或使用 `await` 调用。

### 示例

输入参数取自 [`run.py`](run.py) 中的示例（较长的列表已截短）：

```python
import asyncio
import redfin


async def main():
    property_for_rent = await redfin.scrape_property_for_rent(
        urls=[
            "https://www.redfin.com/WA/Seattle/Onni-South-Lake-Union/apartment/147020546",
            "https://www.redfin.com/WA/Seattle/The-Ivey-on-Boren/apartment/146904423",
        ],
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## 输出

这些函数返回普通的字典和列表。示例输出的字段（第一项的顶层键）：

- [`results/properties_for_sale.json`](results/properties_for_sale.json): `address`, `description`, `price`, `estimatedMonthlyPrice`, `propertyUrl`, `attachments`, `details`, `features`
- [`results/properties_for_rent.json`](results/properties_for_rent.json): `rentalId`, `unitTypesByBedroom`, `totalUnitTypes`, `totalUnits`, `priceDrop`, `mostPopularFloorPlanId`, `mostPopularFloorPlanClickCount`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `mlsId`, `showMlsId`, `mlsStatus`, `showDatasourceLogo`, `price`, `hideSalePrice`, `hoa`, `isHoaFrequencyKnown`, `sqFt`, `pricePerSqFt`, `lotSize`, `beds`, `baths`, `location`, `latLong`, `streetLine`, `unitNumber`, `city`, `state`, `zip`, `postalCode`, `countryCode`, `showAddressOnMap`, `soldDate`, `searchStatus`, `propertyType`, `uiPropertyType`, `listingType`, `propertyId`, `listingId`, `dataSourceId`, `isEarlyAccess`, `earlyAccessType`, `marketId`, `yearBuilt`, `dom`, `timeOnRedfin`, `timeZone`, `primaryPhotoDisplayLevel`, `photos`, … (23 更多)

## Scrapfly 设置

[`redfin.py`](redfin.py) 中的 `BASE_CONFIG` 保存请求的默认设置，参见 [Scrape API 文档](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started)：

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly 的 [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)，即其反机器人绕过功能
- `country` = `"US"`: 代理所在国家

## 快速开始

需要 Python 3.10 及以上版本和 [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation)。

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/redfin-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # 获取地址： https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # 示例抓取，结果保存在 ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # 运行该爬虫的测试
```

测试：`test_properties_for_sale_scraping`, `test_properties_for_rent_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`；使用 `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>` 运行单个测试。 `run.py` 和测试会抓取真实网站，因此会消耗 Scrapfly 积分。
